description: This file is a CMake module script designed to find and configure the libsystemd library within a project. It handles locating the library, include directories, and setting up compilation/linking properties accordingly.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Locates and configures external packages, in this case, libsystemd.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Checks for pkg-config modules related to libsystemd.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Finds the library file for systemd.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes other CMake scripts, such as FindPackageHandleStandardArgs.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Validates the presence of required components for the package.
